name: Merciful
body:
You know the value of mercy, and do not have to slay your opponents to defeat them.

Prerequisite(s): Non-evil alignment, challenge class feature

Benefit: All of your weapons may deal nonlethal damage to the target of your challenge. In addition, Heal is a class skill for you.
